original_value: The article deals with the organization of project training within the university education through the construction of individual educational routes. The authors believe that the value orientationsand the motivationsystem are not only interrelated, but also mutually influence each other, which confirms the need to study value orientations when building an individual route. Based on the Milton Rokich questionnaire, the authors identify three groups of students based on their value orientations. The stages of building individual educational routes are also presented.

result.paraphrase: The article examines how project-based learning is organized in university education through the development of individual educational pathways. The authors argue that value orientations and the motivation system are not only interconnected but also mutually influential, which supports the need to assess value orientations when designing an individual route. Using the Milton Rokich questionnaire, they identify three student groups according to their value orientations. The paper also outlines the stages of constructing individual educational routes.
